name: The Vermilion Mask
summary: The mask brings calamity. The mask revels in slaughter. The mask has a will of its own... Pelle, a traveling mask merchant, possesses the ability to craft mysterious masks that give its wearers unique powers. In a city shrouded in an eerie atmosphere, he encounters Sonah, a mysterious young girl. As revelations unfold and inner conflicts arise, a young boy takes his first steps forward! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mask battle fantasy!

name: Catedrales
summary: Catedrales is told across two timelines as the Sardá family confronts the devastating truth behind a thirty-year-old murder. In 1986, Ana, the youngest daughter of the devoutly religious family, is found dismembered and burned in a vacant lot. The case is closed without a suspect, and the family accepts their grief in silence — all except Lía, who walks away from everything. In 2018, Lía returns to Santiago to be with her dying father, whose last wish is to learn what happened to Ana. Moving between past and present, the series unravels a history steeped in religious extremism, forbidden love, and a web of lies that destroyed them all.

name: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
summary: Mitsutaka Oji is a 40-year-old, handsome office worker that is admired by his colleagues. Of course, he has a secret he is trying to hide from everyone: he loves cute things. But with his nephew going to his apartment, Mitsutaka's secret is now in danger!

name: Vertex Force
summary: Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family, however, harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira, on the other hand, has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events begin to occur around the world.

name: #I'm Looking For Zombie
summary: Set in a world where 90 percent of humans on Earth have contracted and died from a deadly, virulent disease, only to then rise again as zombies who attack people. 13 years after that "Red Day" of societal and civilizational collapse, the surviving humans live outside the big cities, still hoping to retake them someday. An entirely new generation of people who know nothing of the pre-Red Day world is now coming into its own. The story begins when Aki and her close friends, Haru and Natsuki, set out to find Aki's missing father.

name: Even Though She's a Timid Young Lady to the Max, She Agreed to Her Shrewd Fiancé's Bet
summary: Pia is an ordinary grad student who gets reincarnated as a 10-year-old background villainess in an otome game. She remembers the game ends with her engagement to the prime minister's son, Rufus Stan, called off, and her banishment from the land, so she asks Rufus to break the engagement now, while they are young. But her request only piqued Rufus' interest in her further, and he made a bet with her to see if he would really call off their engagement in seven years.

name: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
summary: The Good Witch of the Lake's four-year crush ended in heartbreak with a single request from the object of her affections. Wanting to increase what little time she has with Royal Knight Harij, Rose sends him on a wild-goose chase for the ingredients for a love potion but gets more than she bargained for when the grumbling knight starts visiting her every day to feed her.

name: The World's Strongest Witch
summary: When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, "Internet." This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means...

name: EN-O'CLOCK
summary: A variety show around the K-Pop group ENHYPEN where they complete games, obstacle courses and much more.

name: Love in the Moonlight: Redrawn
summary: The five main cast members—Park Bo Gum, Kim Yoo Jung, Jin Young, Chae Soo Bin, and Kwak Dong Yeon—reunite for a two-day, one-night trip to Hongcheon, where they spend time together, reminisce about the drama and their memories from 10 years ago, and show how their friendships have changed—or stayed the same—over the years.

name: Εξ Αδιαιρέτου
summary:
Efi, a free spirited fashion designer, and Alexandros, a strict and conservative technocrat, unexpectedly find themselves forced to live together after jointly inheriting the same house. Bound by strict legal conditions, the two complete opposites constantly clash over their incompatible lifestyles.

Their ongoing battle over who will have the upper hand turns life under the same roof into constant chaos, as each resorts to increasingly inventive ways to drive the other out of the house.

name: Pac-Man: Snack Breaks
summary:
PAC-MAN is hungry for a new adventure and some fresh flavors! He's leaving his familiar home of PAC-VILLAGE for the bright and bustling NEW PAC-CITY! But what adventures are being cooked up? What a-MAZE-ing challenges will PAC-MAN roll through? 

Find out in PAC-MAN: Snack Breaks, where snack-sized moments turn into feasts of fun and life is not just a 1-player game. Join PAC-MAN along with a colorful cast of characters. Some of whom will help PAC-MAN conquer his day-to-day quests, while others will serve up chaos on a whole new level.

name: La Pola
summary:
New Granada, early 19th century. In this era, there are only two choices: one is either a Royalist or a Patriot. A fierce power struggle is underway, bringing with it injustice, countless tears, executions, war itself.
Against this backdrop, extraordinary stories unfold, for people live each day literally as if it were their last.

This is the setting for the story of La Pola, an untamed spirit, a visionary driven by ideals and a burning desire to fight for freedom, a woman ahead of her time in an era where rampant chauvinism denies women any voice or say.
In an age when love is still eternal and a single kiss means everything, La Pola experiences a tumultuous, painful, and passionate romance with Alejo Sabaraín. He is a man forbidden to her in every respect: a nobleman of Spanish lineage, from a different social class and background, and, crucially, a supporter of the Crown. In short, their relationship is viewed as a sin. Yet, the attraction proves so powerful that the couple strives to embrace their love, regardless of the obstacles, even if it means facing death.

name: Grindl
summary: Driven by an agency manager who sends her to a new temporary assignment every week, an eccentric and highly literal-minded domestic worker blunders her way into bizarre high-stakes situations—ranging from murder mysteries to undercover police ops—accidentally solving the chaos through pure blind luck before moving on to her next job.

name: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring
summary: It's the modern world, where humans, yokai, and various other races coexist. Satoru, who works as the apartment manager, ends up angering his secret crush, Mifuyu, a snow woman who lives in the same building. Eager to make amends, he uses a mysterious ring that is said to help in communicating with yokai. However, he finds himself hotly pursued by Mifuyu, who has suddenly become extremely forward.

name: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
summary: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.

name: Tank Chair
summary: In a dystopian city ruled by violent gangs, a devoted young girl accepts the world's most dangerous assassination contracts to intentionally expose her comatose, wheelchair-bound brother to extreme killing intent—the only catalyst capable of temporarily awakening his unstoppable instincts as a legendary hitman.

name: Squamish Medium
summary: Psychic medium Danielle Searancke uses a connection to Spirit to help people live big and meaningful lives. Disconnected from her Indigenous culture, Danielle is on a journey of reconnection: to self, family, culture, and the land itself.

name: Breitscheidplatz 19/12
summary: About a week before Christmas 2016, a truck plowed into the popular holiday market at Breitscheidplatz, a crowded public square. Twelve people died and many were injured in Germany's deadliest terror attack in decades.

name: Project XY
summary: Using a 'Search for the Leading Actor' format, the show will cast the main and supporting CPs for our company's debut BL drama. It creates a complete business loop across talent-building, drama incubation, fan economy, and merchandise, serving as the launchpad for Chinese-language BL content on the global stage. Six men arrive at a seaside house as complete strangers, each searching for the partner who matches him best.

name: Η Ελίζα και οι Άλλοι
summary: Eliza Stamatiou lives with her mother, Margarita, and her younger brother, Giorgos, somewhere in Brahami. Their financial situation is very good and everyone at home has relative freedom of movement. Eliza works for a large insurance company, but her "secret" desire is to work in cinema, regardless of her specialty. In the boredom of everyday life and a rather indifferent life, Eliza juxtaposes her imagination, which has been fueled by endless hours in movie theaters or in front of the video. Her generally unsuccessful attempts to transfer elements and situations from movies and their corresponding heroines to her daily life, provoke laughter and emotion.

name: Εμείς κι Εμείς
summary: A heartwarming Greek sitcom centered on the daily lives, romantic misadventures, and enduring bond of a close-knit group of thirty-something friends and neighbors living in an apartment building in Athens.

name: Double Shuffle
summary: Fan Chiang Jui Chen, heir to a powerful family, becomes ruthless amid deadly power struggles. His only weakness is his love for his seventh uncle, Fan Wei Hsia. Their bond ends in tragedy when Jui Chen dies saving Wei Hsi, who is later murdered seeking revenge. Fate sends Wei Hsi back to his youth with memories of their past life. Determined to change their destiny, he protects Jui Chen, only to findhim colder than before. When an accident restores Jui Chen's memories, they must confront old wounds and decide whether love can overcome fate.

name: Котляревський
summary: The series revolves around the fast-paced, dramatic, and humorous everyday life of the staff working at a fictional restaurant named Kotliarevskyi.

name: Building Buffalo
summary: Building Buffalo tells the story of the laborers, tradespeople, architects and contractors who built the Bills' state-of-the-art stadium, featuring Bills legends Thurman Thomas, Andre Reed and Steve Tasker alongside current players Damar Hamlin, Dawson Knox, DJ Moore and others.

name: A Course Called Ireland
summary:
This isn't just a show about golf — it's a celebration of life going gloriously off course. In this series, Bill Murray and good friend and author, Tom Coyne play their way across some of the island's most legendary golf courses. But somewhere between the first tee and the final pint, the journey veers off course to meet the people who give it its soul, and why Bill loves his Irish heritage so much.

Each episode follows Murray and friends across some of the island's most breathtaking fairways, with every episode featuring a different golf course and guest.

The series offers an intimate portrait of an island whose stories, people and craic prove just as unforgettable as Bill Murray himself.

Golf is just the excuse.

name: Mr. Gu, Happy Trial Marriage
summary:
Shen Zhiyi, a bride-to-be, finds out she is unexpectedly pregnant due to a bizarre medical mix-up. When she subsequently discovers her fiancé's infidelity, she calls off the wedding immediately and decides to raise the child alone as a single mother. Two years later, Gu Chenzhou—the cold, powerful president of the prominent Gu Group—presents her with a DNA test proving he is the biological father of her child.

To give their son a complete family, Gu Chenzhou proposes a "trial marriage" contract with strict terms, promising a temporary arrangement with no romantic obligations. Despite his initially aloof demeanor, Gu Chenzhou becomes fiercely protective and devoted to both Shen Zhiyi and their child. What began as a businesslike arrangement transforms into real affection as Shen Zhiyi realizes Mr. Gu fell in love with her long before the "trial" ever began.

name: Психологическая импровизация
summary: Psychological Improvisation is a show in which viewers ask personal questions to psychologist Maya Zozzatti right from the audience and receive a quick and clear analysis of their situations. Love, money, family, complexes and fears – in each episode, we explore what worries us, hinders our understanding of ourselves, and prevents us from building relationships with others.

name: Tyson
summary: In this surprisingly emotional documentary, heavyweight champ Mike Tyson analyzes the controversies surrounding his career and turbulent private life.

name: Shaun the Sheep: Brain Breaks
summary: Shaun the Sheep is here to get you up and moving as you take on fun games and challenges. Featuring all your Mossy Bottom Farm friends!

name: Saman: La verità nascosta
summary: Saman, la verità nascosta (Saman, The Hidden Truth) is a three-part docuseries that reconstructs the tragic story of Saman Abbas, the 18-year-old Pakistani girl killed in Novellara in 2021. Blending investigative journalism with cinematic storytelling, the series explores the clash between the young woman's desire for freedom and the rigid dictates of her family. It traces her rebellion, her tragic disappearance, and the complex investigation that culminated in the international judicial process.

name: The Mafia Nanny
summary: The Mafia Nanny centers on Davina who serves as an elite nanny to high-net-worth families. Her job should be straightforward: protect the charge, obey the client, and avoid becoming emotionally attached. But when Davina receives her first mission in the form of young Mikey Angelini, his imposing – and alluring – father threatens to drag her back into the world of organized crime she had tried to leave behind.

name: Hard Feelings
summary: Hard Feelings follows Claire Ambrose, New York City's most sought-after dating consultant, who teaches straight men communication skills and emotional intelligence while repeatedly choosing to date men who possess neither.

name: Katie Greaves
summary: Katie Greaves centers on the titular Katie Greaves, a whip-smart, fiercely committed attorney who stepped away from the New Hampshire Public Defender's office following a devastating personal tragedy. Now raising her two young granddaughters with her husband and trying to piece together a life she never expected, Katie is drawn back to the work that once defined her. Each case tests Katie's instincts, wit, and deeply held belief that everyone deserves a second chance... and someone to fight for them.

name: Perfectos mentirosos
summary: Jude Derry arrives at this exclusive university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. The three heirs to the family empire dominate Tagus with a magnetism that no one can resist. There's Aegan, the charismatic and calculating firstborn, Adrik, the enigmatic and mysterious middle brother, and Aleixandre, the rebellious and unpredictable youngest.

name: HaPijamot
summary: HaPijamot is an Israeli television sitcom about a struggling band determined to make it in the real world. The show follows the misadventures of three childhood friends: Ilan, Kobi and Oded, as they move from Netanya to Tel Aviv to launch their band. Unlike many shows, the characters in the show are aware that they are on television; the show features their day-to-day lives. A major aspect of the show is "HaMasach HaLavan" (the white screen), where cast members talk to the viewers. Gary, Kobi's uncle, who own the "hamburgary", also talks to the viewers when he is alone in his Black screen, often complaining about his wife or just his life in general. There are several interactive episodes, such as an episode which the viewers can fast forward or rewind to decide the outcome of the episode, an episode in which the viewers can record ringtones, and an episode with a cheaper form of scratch-and-sniff. The show always ends with the "Shtifat Kelim" - the characters washing the dishes for Gary and summarize the episode

name: The Serial Killer Connection
summary: The Serial Killer Connection reveals an unlikely bond forged in the aftermath of a serial killer's crimes. Decades after marrying   Richard "Marc" Evonitz at a young age, Bonnie Lou learns that her former husband had been living a horrifying double life as a serial killer – with his deadly secret ultimately revealed after Kara Robinson Chamberlain's courageous escape from captivity. Years later, an unexpected connection sparked by a social media trend brings the two women together, transforming shared trauma into a determined quest for answers. United by a singular mission, the ex-wife and survivor of a serial killer unite in their determination to uncover the untold life and crimes of Evontiz and as they dig deeper, they confront the chilling possibility that the full scope of his crimes has yet to be revealed.

name: Grande de España
summary: Don Leandro, a ruined marquis who lives on appearances and dreams of being named a Grandee of Spain, sees only one way out of his financial disaster: selling his decaying family mansion in Madrid. The perfect opportunity seems to arise when the immensely wealthy businesswoman Sofía Carrington takes an interest in the property. But as the negotiations (and seductions) progress, it becomes clear that they are not who they appear to be.

name: #Love
summary: A practical dating app founder and her adventurous competitor test their opposing theories about love through a 60-day challenge to find the right match.

name: O Espião Que Veio do Futebol
summary: Set in Lisbon in 1941, during the height of World War II, neutral Portugal has become a hotbed of international espionage. Cândido de Oliveira—a former national football team player, co-founder of the Portuguese sports newspaper A Bola, and former manager of the Portuguese national team—uses his public fame, sporting travels, and media access as a cover to set up an anti-fascist intelligence network code-named Britânicos. Operating on behalf of the British Secret Intelligence Service (MI6) under the nose of Salazar's Estado Novo secret police (PVE), he works to smuggle intelligence and assist refugees, leading to his eventual arrest, torture, and imprisonment at the Tarrafal concentration camp in Cape Verde.

name: The Spread
summary: Miami is turning paradise into power — Wall Street South — a subtropical collision of industry titans, elite hedge funds, staggering wealth, ruthless competition, sex, nightlife and fun on an industrial scale. Into this sun-soaked arena comes a visionary billionaire who collects the brilliant, the hungry and the dangerous, then turns their ambitions loose on the markets that power America. He chases something bigger: the power to shift the center of economic gravity to Miami — and decide how long the party lasts.

name: Roadtrip Nation
summary: The show follows groups of young adults traveling across the country in a signature green RV. Along the way, the "roadtrippers" interview leaders, creators, and professionals across diverse industries to uncover how they turned their personal passions into fulfilling careers.

name: Bucks County, USA
summary: Evi and Vanessa, two 14-year-olds living in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, are best friends despite their opposing political beliefs. As nationwide disputes explode into vitriol and division in their hometown, the girls and others in the community work to navigate their differences and find a new path forward for their community.

name: Ladies of the House
summary: In Ladies of the House, when the charismatic owner of a winery dies unexpectedly, his wife and two adult daughters must battle through their issues with each other in order to confront challenges with the business, their extended family, and the men in their lives. Good friends and good wine will aid in the journey to hang on to the winery, but what matters most is that they find a way to hang on to each other.

name: All the Rage
summary: All the Rage is a half-hour dark revenge comedy about Emma and Eli, old friends who reconnect after a long estrangement and find new purpose in taking down the man who tore them apart.

name: Cautiva
summary: A devout young woman enters a cloistered convent, never imagining that her spirit will be crushed by the Mother Superior's abuses.

name: Kåss går det?
summary: Comedian Else Kåss Furuseth sets out alongside four ordinary individuals to unravel the mysteries of loneliness and social isolation, embarking on a candid journey to break taboos, share personal stories, and foster a genuine sense of belonging.

name: Legend of Nine Nights
summary: At the beginning of the spiritual world, the yin and yang are not divided, the spirits create all things in the spiritual world, and in the source of the gods, turn their power into Nine Holy Heavenly Weapon to maintain the spirit. Emperor Torch suddenly discovered the method of cultivating spiritual energy and became the king of the first generation to rule the human race. Before his death, he said: Those who inherit the Nine Holy Heavenly Weapon will gain eternal life and be with the world. Nowadays, ordinary people can only live in a city protected by the Holy Heaven Weapon. The spiritual world is divided by the Xuanyang, the Shadowmoon Clan, and the Mountain Sea Alliance, maintaining peace in a delicate balance. Liuli, the heir of the Shadowmoon Clan, is talented and everyone hopes that she can make the clan rise again. But Liuli only wants to be lazy and live a simple, easy life.

previousepisode.name: Zuster Kirsten maakt een eerlijke balans op van haar kloosterleven

name: Michael Palin in the Philippines
summary: Michael Palin's latest adventure is an epic 2,500-mile journey across the islands of the Philippines. Known as an idyllic tropical travel hotspot, Michael also delves deeper to reveal a surprising, darker side. The legacy of Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos' spending, not just the shoes of legend but billions spent on monumental architecture, still haunts the country forty years on. Their son, Bongbong Marcos, is now President, and forty percent of the urban population lives in poverty, thirty thousand people have been lawlessly killed by vigilante anti-drug 'death squads', and a third of the country is on the UK Foreign Office 'do not travel list'. But despite all of this, Michael also experiences the Philippines as, ironically, one of the happiest and certainly the most beautiful countries he has ever visited.

name: Hennesey
summary: A dedicated U.S. Navy doctor stationed at a San Diego naval base balances the daily medical and personal misadventures of military life alongside a charming base nurse and his eccentric commanding officer.

name: The Hollow Men
summary: Four British comedians deliver surreal, fast-paced sketch comedy built around absurd scenarios, everyday awkwardness, and physical humor.

name: Hullabaloo
summary: Hullabaloo is an American musical variety series that ran on NBC from January 12, 1965 through August 29, 1966. Similar to Shindig! it ran in prime time in contrast to ABC's American Bandstand.

name: The Origin of Love
summary:
A story that follows Ji Yichuan, a gifted young warrior of the Ji clan who encounters all kinds of hardships yet ultimately relies on his own strength to defend his home.

While under orders to guard a monster, Ji Yichuan chances upon a sacred beast. Along the way, he meets Yu Chixue. Ji Yichuan must face punishment for his infraction as the monster escaped. Yu Chixue gets seriously injured in her attempt to help him capture the monster. He secures the help of Lan Lingyu, a disciple of the Medicine King. Ji Yichuan embarks on a journey with Yu Chixue and Lan Lingyu in search for the immortal land. They cross paths with Shao Yan Wang who has assumed the pseudonym Wang Yan. Shao Yan Wang feigns kindness while pulling the strings from the background. Through many trials and tribulations, they discover the mastermind.

name: Rivalerne
summary: A biologist's struggle to rewild a river divides the town of Elverkilde, shatters her family, and uncovers dark secrets from the past.

nextepisode.name: Hvem er bange for Johannes Gade?

name: Rachel Maddow: In Conversation With…
summary: A monthly long-form interview series hosted by Rachel Maddow exploring politics, history, and public life.

name: The Very Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell
summary: A weekly behind-the-scenes program hosted by Lawrence O'Donnell looking at stories that did not fit into his regular television broadcast.

name: Because We Care with Richard Lui
summary: Because We Care with Richard Lui is an exclusive talk series on the MS NOW platform where anchor and caregiving advocate Richard Lui brings caregivers front and center by sitting down with public figures, founders, and innovators to share personal stories of compassion, practical solutions, and resources.

name: Off the Charts with Ali Velshi
summary: Off the Charts with Ali Velshi features Ali Velshi at the MS NOW "Big Board" to provide a deeper dive into the latest polling, voter data, and political numbers. [1]

name: Answers with Andrew Weissmann
summary: Andrew Weissmann, MS NOW Legal Analyst and former FBI General Counsel, is answering YOUR legal news questions. Join the discussion on the Community page and submit your legal news questions for Andrew to answer in a future episode.

name: Political Potluck with Claire McCaskill
summary: Hosted by Claire McCaskill, featuring conversations with lawmakers and everyday people across the Midwest.

name: Jep!
summary: Jep! a children's version of Jeopardy!

name: Unsoiled Starlight
summary: Shu Tinglan, scarred by family trauma from her upbringing, grew into a sensitive, love-starved young woman. As an adult, she crosses paths with Zhuo Yu'an, the CEO of a tech company, through work. What neither realizes at first is that they were already close back in high school, only to be torn apart by a misunderstanding at graduation. When they reunite, they find themselves in an unexpected client-and-vendor relationship. Through every trial and emotional twist along the way, the two finally find their happily-ever-after.

name: Girasoles para Lucía
summary:
Lucía Trevi has two dreams in life: to become a famous Hollywood actress and to win the love of José Simón Landaeta. She knows the first is practically impossible... but the second, why not? Like Cinderella, this cheerful, sweet, yet poor young woman believes that dreams can come true if one desires them intensely enough. Perhaps as a reward for such optimism, life grants Lucía the opportunity she craves: to connect with the distinguished Landaeta family and thereby get closer to her idol. One afternoon, while making a delivery for the deli where she works, Lucía falls victim to a pickpocket... and the man who comes to her rescue, purely by chance, is Roberto Landaeta, José Simón's brother.

Handsome and charming, yet down-to-earth and kind, Roberto is captivated by Lucía's beauty and warmth, and begins to woo her. Upon learning that she comes from humble means and must work to support her father, Roberto decides that to win Lucía's love on his own merits, free from the influence of his surname and fortune, he should hide his true identity. He tells her he is a labourer at the Landaeta corporation, rather than revealing that he is one of its owners.

A beautiful friendship blossoms between Roberto and Lucía, even though she cannot stop thinking about her "Prince Charming," José Simón. She sees him in society magazines, unaware that he is closer than she imagines. Unlike Roberto, José Simón is arrogant, domineering, and dismissive of anyone he considers socially inferior. He would never take notice of a girl like Lucía, despite the countless schemes she devises to meet him. She only manages to catch his attention through a misunderstanding, when he happens to mistake her for the aristocratic Countess of Fernese.

name: Year After Year
summary: A thousand years ago, Jiang Shiwei, the eldest daughter of a noble family, fell in love with Se Chen, the son of a military officer; but, bound by the fates of their families, they took their own lives together. Carrying with her memories of her past life and an unwavering desire to love with all her heart, Shiwei searched for Se Chen from one life to the next and finally met him again. She proposed to him, but he flatly refused. Disappointed, she unexpectedly ran into Se Chen once more, and he gradually...

name: Scribes & Scriveners
summary: On each episode of Scribes & Scriveners, we sit down with a Black Library author to discuss their books. They take us inside their writing process and reveal the secrets of creating fan favourite stories and characters.

name: The Secret of Lost Creek
summary: Two siblings spending a summer vacation at their grandparents' house turn a boring rural stay into a thrilling quest when the sister discovers clues to a hidden buried treasure and her brother becomes obsessed with tracking down Bigfoot.

name: Slobby's World
summary: Robert Hall is obsessed with pop culture from 1980s and 1990s, and other collectors are obsessed with him. At his Tucson store, Generation Cool, he buys, sells and trades luxury leather bags, jerseys, sneakers, toys, games, jewelry and bootleg clothing from that era. His friends call him SLOBBY ROBBY – welcome to his world.

name: Mr. Men Little Miss Mini Adventures
summary: Get to know the Mr. Men and Little Misses. Join your favorite characters in simple adventures and learn lessons from them along the way.

name: Never Worry Alone with Dan Harris
summary: Never Worry Alone is an MS NOW series hosted by Dan Harris that encourages people to lean on one another to combat suffering, anxiety, and political polarization.

name: The Week in Sanity with Dan Harris
summary: Catch The Week in Sanity every Saturday, where Dan breaks down the week's news with your sanity in mind, and ‘Never Worry Alone' live every Monday, where he answers YOUR questions LIVE and offers practical advice for coping with today's stressors.

name: The Parenting Shift with Dr. Ann-Louise Lockhart
summary: Navigating family dynamics, technology, teen development, and modern parenting challenges

name: Dear Nedra
summary: Licensed therapist, relationship expert, and bestselling author Nedra Glover Tawwab answers members' questions about the intersection of relationships, family dynamics, and today's social climate, offering practical advice rooted in empathy, communication, and healthy boundaries.

name: Myth or Medicine? with Dr. Joel Bervell
summary: Dr. Joel Bervell addresses widespread health misinformation and debunks medical myths, using his background as a science communicator and physician to challenge biases and inequities within the healthcare system.

name: The Simple One
summary: Bat El is engaged to Nahorai, they have been together since the annual trip in the 11th grade. After he unexpectedly broke up with her on their Hina, Batzi finds herself single for the first time since high school. The reason for the breakup: she lacks vitality, or ambitions, or work, or in short - simple. Batzi enrolls in communications studies at Savidor Merzac College and becomes a full-fledged student. She breaks out of her shell with her two besties, Timor and Nofer, and together they rent an apartment in Tel Aviv. They also have one roommate, Topaz, who keeps quiet.

name: King of Survival: Tribal War
summary: 12-member cast, which fights its way through the jungle and "survival" for the "throne", also consists of the best talents in their fields. Those who have proven their skills through various survival pastimes, such as backcountry exploration experts, martial arts, national team athletes and former special forces, put their pride on the line and give it all to the "King of Survival".

name: Hugh and I Spy
summary: After returning home from a world cruise, two bumbling, clueless best friends are accidentally recruited by MI5 and unwittingly dragged into a high-stakes world of international espionage and crime.

name: Cycle of Sin
summary: After Yo discovers that her husband Nat has been cheating on her with his boss Pam, they decide to try repairing their bond by moving away to Nat's great-grandmother's house, along with Wan, Yo's trusted assistant. However, their attempts at reconciliation soon go awry when strange, horrifying incidents begin taking place in and around the house, along with the appearance of the mysterious Pete. As Yo tries to figure out what's going on, she realizes that both the house and the people around her are cloaked in secrets and lies, creating a perfect storm of danger that she might not manage to escape from – especially when the past refuses to leave the present alone.

name: Holidate
summary: Touted as a reality-television take on the 2006 Cameron Diaz and Kate Winslet movie The Holiday, each episode sent two participants from different parts of the country to trade places. A woman from one city would travel to another and go on three separate dates with three different local bachelors, while her counterpart did the same in reverse.

name: NaturNah
summary: Floodplains, lakes, primeval forests, winding streams - large parts of our natural landscape have disappeared in the last few decades; they were displaced by the construction of roads, residential and industrial areas, and by the expansion of agricultural land. NATUR-NAH presents the remaining near-natural biotopes and shows the plants and animals living there in extraordinary close-ups, presenting nature up close. Consignment list

name: Trezor
summary: Security guard Sonja wakes up locked inside a looted bank vault with a gap in her memory. Detectives Deja and Jaka believe she was involved in the robbery.

name: Finding Britain's Slave Traders with David Olusoga
summary:
Finding Britain's Slave Traders with David Olusoga is set to explore the individuals, institutions and organisations who financed Britain's trade in enslaved Africans from its first tentative steps in the 16th century to abolition of the trade in 1807.

Based on exclusive access to the findings of a new academic research project, led by Professor William Pettigrew, this series follows the work of the research team who, over five years, built a new database; the Register of British Slave Traders.

The series paints a forensic portrait of the traders and investors and the vast and complex system of investment and profits they created. It shows where they lived, how much money they made and uncovers links between modern British institutions and the trade in enslaved people.

Twelve years ago, in the series Britain's Forgotten Slave Owners, David Olusoga explored the compensation paid to Britain's slave owners when slavery in the British Empire was abolished in 1833. This new series uncovers the identities and the back stories of the slave traders – the thousands of individuals and organisations who engaged in the trade in human beings.

name: Murder USA
summary: Murder USA is a true-crime series that takes viewers inside homicide investigations from everyday American communities. Drawing on local news archive, police audio and first-hand testimony, each episode reconstructs a case from the moment the crime occurs through the twists, setbacks and breakthroughs of the investigation. The series explores how violent crime ripples through families, neighbourhoods and towns, with insight from witnesses, journalists and experts close to each case. Murder USA shows how violence can hide in plain sight, and how justice is ultimately pursued in communities across the United States.

name: Battle Spirits [Re]: The Sky of the Absolute Realm
summary: Set in Eito, Hinomoto, during a turbulent era later known as the end of the Edo period, a strength-seeking boy drawn to Battle Spirits named Ku Bashin crosses paths with a mysterious, promise-bound man known as the "Assassin" (Zetsu Ajara), intersecting their paths and setting history in motion.

name: Chefs Ahoy
summary:
Hosted by beloved Australian comedian Peter Helliar, this light-hearted yet fierce competition drops two top chefs per episode into a high-seas culinary showdown where up to 4,000 hungry passengers decide the winner at "The Captain's Dinner".

Celebrating the luxury and comfort of ocean cruising aboard Princess Cruises, Chefs Ahoy takes viewers on an unforgettable voyage – from the sun-soaked shores of Greece and the bustling streets of Korea to the vibrant food cultures of Japan and Spain.

Part travel adventure and all foodie delight, each episode lifts the rival chefs way out of their comfort zones. After port-hopping to taste local authentic flavours, the chefs dock back on board to face their biggest hurdle: scaling up their signature dishes alongside the ship's elite crew. With time ticking, unfamiliar galleys and professional reputations on the line, the pressure reaches boiling point as they then serve up their creations to the passengers.

name: Shaun Micallef's Parents' Evening
summary:
Australian comedy royalty Shaun Micallef is returning to Network 10 with a brand-new comedy game show: Shaun Micallef's Parents' Evening. And because family is everything, he's recruited his son, Gabe Micallef, to co-host.

In this new cross-generational game show, it doesn't matter what you know. It matters what your mum or dad think you know.

Here's the deal. Each week, three well-known Australians team up with their lesser-known parent or child. A topic is presented, and the parents have to guess how many correct answers their grown-up kid will know.

If they get it right, they're cruising toward victory. If they get it wrong, they can enjoy a very awkward drive home.

name: The Vault
summary: The most memorable Notre Dame football games of all-time with strong feats of athletic achievement and true accomplishments of the head and the heart.

name: Вор в загоне
summary: A Moscow psychologist visits his fiancée's parents in a provincial town and begins treating her father—a local crime boss suffering from an anxiety disorder.

name: Armies of Renown
summary: Pulling from the vast wealth of experience in the Warhammer team, Armies of Renown showcases impressive conversion and painting work – and asks the creators for advice and inspiration.

name: Bad Blood
summary:
Bad Blood tells the story of how more than 30,000 people were administered contaminated blood and blood products between the 1970s and the early 1990s, resulting in life-shattering chronic illnesses and more than 3,000 deaths.

The drama centres around four boys at Treloar's, a unique boarding school for disabled children with an attached specialised NHS centre for haemophiliacs whose lives would otherwise have been defined by regular and gruelling trips to the hospital.

While at Treloar's, the boys are given Factor VIII, a revolutionary treatment that promises them the possibility of an increased lifespan and greater freedoms. Unbeknown to them or their parents, the doctors whom the boys trust with their lives use them as guinea pigs in trials to test blood products, some of which are sourced from high-risk, paid donors in the United States, including prisoners.

When the medical establishment learns of the transmission of new diseases, Hepatitis C and Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS), they fail to act and people across the country are exposed. As the drama unfolds, the children at Treloar's begin to show signs of the diseases.

Bad Blood will dramatise the institutional failures within Government and the medical establishment that led to this avoidable disaster and the cover-up that has tried to hide these failures. It will also show the decades-long fight by the survivors and their families for truth and justice.

name: Strictly: Lights Up
summary: Hosted by comedian Abi Clarke and presenter and Strictly alum Tyler West, Strictly: Lights Up will be available immediately after the results show has finished. Abi and Tyler will take viewers straight on to the Strictly dance floor for immediate reactions from the night's eliminated couple, their dance off opponents - plus the judges, hosts, other Strictly stars and studio guests.

name: Martin Compston: Living Las Vegas
summary: Actor Martin Compston offers an insider's tour of Las Vegas, revealing the secrets, thrills, and irresistible allure that makes his adopted home the ultimate playground

De Augurkenkoning
summary: The striking Oos Kesbeke—better known as 'The Pickle King'—stands at the helm of his massive pickle empire. He presides over the family business, proud as a peacock and never mincing his words.

name: Acting Out
summary: A young gay actor named Bogie is trying to avoid being typecast by "faking it straight" to everyone but his closest friends. Dubious help from friends, and his own insecurity, complicate matters as Bogie navigates the Hollywood game.

name: Sergio Perera's Destination Peru
summary: Sergio Perera journeys through Peru alongside Minoli De Silva and Conor Curran, exploring the country's landscape, its people and its food.

name: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces: First Home
summary:
Britain is in the grip of a housing crisis, with many people unable to afford a traditional bricks-and-mortar home. In this new series, George meets the proactive and determined people finding creative ways to put a roof over their heads.

Across four episodes, George and his long-time collaborator Will Hardie meet individuals, couples and families driven to create homes in unconventional spaces. From buses and boats to former toilet blocks and tiny homes, the series follows those transforming unexpected places into affordable homes of their own.

Through ambitious builds and personal stories, George discovers how hard work, enthusiasm and, sometimes, clever left-field thinking can help turn unlikely spaces into beautiful, practical and life-changing places to live.

name: Η αγάπη άργησε μια μέρα
summary: The story takes us to Neochori in Crete, Athens, and Galaxidi, spanning the period from the Occupation (1944) to the mid-1960s. We follow the drama of the traditional family of Michailos Ftenoudos, which begins when his youngest daughter becomes pregnant by an Italian man just as her father is slowly dying.

name: Bride of the Barrier Master
summary: For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. But that ideal lifestyle begins to slip out of reach when Saku Ichinomiya takes over as the new head of the Ichinomiya clan and sets out to find a bride strong enough to stand by his side. Eager to keep her abilities secret, Hana steers clear of Saku... but will she be tempted to sign a marriage contract if it guarantees the peaceful, quiet future of her dreams?

name: Quiztopia
summary: In an alternate Japan, a charismatic host runs a deadly quiz where winners get any wish and losers pay dearly. His world unravels when rebels target him.

name: Metal Armor Dragonar
summary: A.D. 2087 - the United Lunar Empire Giganos wages war on the Earth Federation Military to take control of the planet and establish a "rebirth" of the human race. During an invasion of a colony by Giganos' forces, three civilian men stumble upon a trio of top-secret Metal Armor units called "Dragonars" and pilot them to combat the enemy forces.

name: Scotland's Golden Coast
summary: A joyous journey along Scotland's sublime and wildly beautiful east coast, from the Moray Firth to the Borders, as we meet the people who work and play here, and those lucky enough to call it home.

name: Rules of Prey
summary: Rules of Prey follows Lucas Davenport, formerly a detective in the Minneapolis Police Department, drawn out of seclusion back into law enforcement to investigate a series of confounding murders designed to send a message specifically to him. When an ingenious serial killer begins murdering Minneapolis citizens, Davenport, a brilliant polymath and unconventional investigator, takes the case, sparking an intense psychological duel with an equally intelligent adversary. As Davenport deciphers the killer's twisted moral code and personal vendetta, he must match wits with a predator operating by his own rules of justice, risking everything to stop a killer who sees their conflict as the ultimate game.

name: Pico dos Marins: O Caso do Escoteiro Marco Aurélio
summary: In 1985, boy scout Marco Aurélio disappears on Marins Peak. Under the watchful eye of his father, Ivo Simon, we follow the new investigations that could finally bring closure to the case.

name: 35-sai, Imasara Koi toka Arienai
summary: After a one-night stand unexpectedly turns into a second chance, a commitment-shy freelance writer must decide whether she's finally ready to open her heart to love.

name: Darkwing Duck
summary: For the last 35 years, Darkwing Duck has been trapped in his worst nightmare: an alternate world that's never heard of his superhero exploits. Now a rebellious teen named Duckie who knows all about his heroic past shows up to pull this ego-fueled vigilante back into battle. Together, this unlikely duo will get dangerous to fight old enemies like Negaduck and Megavolt and reunite with allies Launchpad, Gosalyn and Morgana to save the entire universe.

name: Revenge
summary: Ye Ting Yan returns from the brink of death to seek revenge against the emperor and empress. He was once the noble Crown Prince Song Ling, he was framed by his younger brother Song Lan and seemingly betrayed by his fiancee, Su Luo Wei. After assuming a new identity as the powerful minister Ye Ting Yan, he uses Su Luo Wei as a pawn in his deadly game of revenge. But when the truth finally emerges, they put aside years of misunderstanding and join forces to overthrow the tyrant, clear his name and restore peace to the nation.

name: Coffin Moon
summary: Coffin Moon is set during a brutal winter in 1975 in Oregon and follows a veteran and his adopted niece as they hunt—and are hunted by—the vampire that slaughtered their family.

name: Your Personal Taxi
summary: There are times when all we want is for someone to truly listen to our story. And sometimes, we come across a song that feels like it's telling that story for us. Welcome to Your Personal Taxi—a special ride where music plays alongside memories, and your story is met with a listening ear. This isn't just any car—it's a personalized classic, and there's something quietly mysterious about it. Passengers with ordinary yet extraordinary lives step in to share personal stories, along with the songs that carry their emotions.

name: People I've Met
summary: An original Be'er Sheva comedy set in the "Simi Center" neighborhood shopping mall, bringing to the screen the stories and dreams of the wild, colorful characters who hang out there. Meet Dalila, from the shop that stocks everything except customers; Popeye, the exterminator ranked only 50th in the South (ever since he accidentally exterminated a Schnauzer); Haviv and Naor, two teens dreaming of getting into the Forum club and escaping the neighborhood; Linoy and Avichai, who run a pizzeria with sesame seeds on the crust; Nadir the greengrocer, looking for love; Hezi, trying to find a tenth man for the prayer quorum; Menachem, searching for his donkey; and many others we've met—and want you to meet, too.

name: Hearsay
summary: A detective transferred to Jerusalem's Central Investigations Unit is drawn into rumors of abuse spreading through an ultra-Orthodox neighborhood — and into the buried story of his own childhood.

name: Delusion
summary: Locals blame a ghost for a missing boy. A cynical cop hunts for logical explanations. Superstition clashes with skepticism in this twisty thriller.

name: Shaque: Trust No One
summary: Desperately searching for her missing child, a mother finds dark secrets in her hillside hometown. With Jennifer Winget and Sumeet Vyas.

name: Good Bones
summary: Challenged to step up by his pregnant wife, Sal buys a rundown estate. Problematically, the previous owner died under mysterious circumstances. Now, Sal must solve a cold case and renovate - all before the baby arrives.

name: Ages of Ice
summary: From the Emmy-Award-winning Northern Pictures, Ages of Ice follows the brave scientists pushing the boundaries of exploration and human endeavour in Earth's coldest corners to understand the changes of ice and what this means for our planet's future. In the unforgiving grip of our planet's polar regions, the series will follow these modern-day explorers as they try to understand how the fate of every place and every creature on our planet is tied to these frozen extremes.

name: Summer Vacation
summary: Tells the story of an ordinary 18-year-old high school girl returning to reality after having her mysterious experiences on her summer vacation.

name: Her Baby
summary: Set against the emotional stakes of a long-awaited pregnancy, Her Baby follows Naomi and Cory Marsh as they prepare to welcome their child with the help of Imani, a surrogate who seems almost too good to be true. Warm, devoted, and impossibly attuned to their needs, she moves into the Marsh home to carry the couple's child. But as her presence becomes increasingly intertwined with their lives, Naomi starts to suspect that the woman carrying her baby wants far more than she's letting on.

name: One-Day Room Rescue
summary: In the span of one workday, the Brownstone Boys surprise New York homeowners with a gorgeous one-room, one-day makeover.

name: Spark of the Long March
summary: Set in the pivotal period after the Maogong Meeting during the Long March, a time of tangled conflicts, fierce line struggles, and daunting ethnic work, the drama revolves around the dispute between going north and going south. It recreates how the Party Central Committee safeguarded Party-wide and army-wide unity, and depicts the Red Army bringing ethnic minority people together to face strong foes and coexist in harmony amid extreme hardship, showcasing the indestructible power of ethnic unity on the Long March.

name: Arena of Death
summary: Arena of Death will answer the ultimate question: which heroes, villains, gods, and monsters are the toughest on the tabletop?

name: Deep Strike
summary: Deep Strike is a behind-the-scenes talk and interview show on Warhammer TV via Warhammer+ where presenters interview developers, animators, and creators about the inner workings of Warhammer video games, animations, and miniatures.

name: André Hazes: En Nu...
summary: In the reality series, we see a new phase begin following the final concert of his successful theater tour. He dives right in with his signature positive energy and humor—he isn't one to sit still, and that is exactly what we will see.

name: Inside Victor Lewis-Smith
summary: Victor Lewis-Smith is on the brink of television stardom when a bizarre accident leaves him trapped in an immobile body in St Reith's BBC Hospital. His mind wanders through various conspiratorial theories and diverse subjects, using archive oddities, sketches, music and phone calls.

name: Bite Size Terror
summary: Bite Size Terror is an anthology of short-form horror stories that explores every corner of the genre, from the supernatural and occult to body horror, dark comedy, monsters, and the macabre. From executive producer Peter Rice and GJMD Studio, the series brings a fresh take on the short-form horror format to Tubi previously explored in Hulu's Bite Size Halloween. Across the season, grief, ambition, intimacy, and vulnerability become entry points for something darker, as characters searching for connection, control, or a way forward find themselves confronting forces they do not understand. With a new story and a new nightmare in every episode, Bite Size Terror delivers a sharp, unpredictable collection of horror built to unsettle, surprise, and linger long after each story ends.

summary: 16 reality legends competing for 10 million rubles.

name: Belzebubs
summary: Sløth is a well-meaning stay-at-home dad striving to balance family life with his ambitions as the frontman of a heavy metal band, alongside his unconventional family navigating everyday chaos.

name: Team Moms: Baseball
summary: Team Moms will immerse viewers into the Legendary Prep Academy in Scottsdale, Ariz., an intense baseball prep school for kids between 6th and 12th grade that serves as a feeder to Division 1 college scholarships, NIL deals and ultimately MLB fame. The show will follow the coaches, families and teen athletes who comprise the starting lineup for one of the world's most competitive youth baseball programs.

name: Time Paladin Sakura
summary: Time Paladin Sakura, is a magical girl spinoff of the Da Capo series. It features a Sakura Yoshino as a seemingly ordinary third grader with special powers.

name: Azucena
summary: Azucena, a humble young woman and a wealthy man fight family rejection and a debt-forced marriage to find that their love ultimately triumphs through pregnancy, conflict, and betrayal.

name: De Kroesjes
summary: De Kroesjes balances the chaos and humor of managing a massive household with Wolter's busy career as a performing artist. It features the day-to-day dynamic of their family life in the Netherlands, Wolter's packed concert schedule, and their travel adventures at their newly acquired family finca (villa) in Málaga, Spai

name: Drugsdelta
summary: Oorlogsjournalisten Rudi Vranckx and Sinan Can investigate whether Belgium and the Netherlands are turning into narco-states due to the ruthless international drug trade.

name: Noll Stjärnor
summary: In the series, Erik Haag and Lotta Lundgren visit hotels and restaurants around the world that have received the worst reviews, that is, zero stars in ratings, to find out, among other things, how bad the rooms are in a zero-star hotel.

name: Brennpunkt: Diplomatparet
summary: From diplomacy, peace and success to Epstein friendship and corruption charges. What happened to Terje Rød-Larsen and Mona Juul?

name: Три острова
summary: The project participants are ordinary people from all corners of Russia. Far removed from familiar civilization, they must undergo a series of grueling challenges testing their endurance, agility, resourcefulness, and teamwork. Each day will put their character, resilience, and determination to see things through to the end to the test.

name: Blackmere
summary: An absurd comedy disguised as an incredibly serious crime thriller. Tormented Detective John Blackmere leaves the rain-soaked Northern city of Bleakford for London to avenge his partner's death and catch a ritualistic serial killer before they run out of victims. Contains blood and frowning.

name: Doozie's Doghouse
summary: Doozie is pinching into her very own Doghouse for some puppy-riffic adventures with her best pup Puggie and all her Doozie Dogs. From the creators of DreamWorks Animation's hit series Gabby's Dollhouse, Doozie's Doghouse is a mixed-media companion series that continues the fun with tail-wagging surprises, woof-tastic unboxings, and imaginative play. Creativity is limitless in Doozie's Doghouse!

name: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
summary:
Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body.

Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go.

name: Gabby's Dollhouse: Makers and Bakers
summary: Hosted by Gabby, talented young baker-and-maker duos take on whimsical crafting and baking challenges.

name: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me
summary: Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length. However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media. Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.

name: Puppy Pirates
summary: Did someone take your treasure? Have you lost your loot? Has the dreaded Captain Claw stolen your beloved stuffy? Then call the Puppy Pirates! Four heroic hounds with a nose for adventure, these plucky pups sail the high seas, fetching what you love the most.

name: Now That I Can Control Reality with a Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away on the Girls!
summary: What if you could actually use a mouse cursor in real life? Takumi, the nerdy outcast, harbors unrequited feelings for his first love, Mone, who treats him with disdain. During computer class, Takumi discovers that his mouse cursor extends beyond the screen and into the physical world...?! With this newfound power visible only to him, Takumi sees an opportunity for mischief. He uses the cursor to get revenge on Mone, clicking on sensitive areas and reveling in her reactions. But when an "Intercourse" button appears unexpectedly, Takumi is thrust into a reality he never imagined possible..."Intercourse"?! Could this really be...?!

name: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner
summary: Amona, a dark summoner and demi-human who uses demonic powers, is the newest addition to the party of the uptight priest Roni. Everyone expected the two to dislike each other and to have nothing to do with each other. But to their surprise, on their first day together as an adventuring party, they had a one-night stand...!

name: My Girlfriend's Friend
summary: Takeru Hidaka is an ambitious high school student aiming for medical school. He has just started dating his first girlfriend, Kaori Koga, and to everyone else, their relationship seems perfectly harmonious. However, that peace is threatened when Kaori's best friend, Tomoko Yoshioka, begins to flirt with and seduce Takeru. Caught between loyalty to his girlfriend and Tomoko's advances, Takeru falls into a double life and a complicated affair. Now, he must navigate a web of lies that puts both his academic future and his emotional connections at risk, all while the constant threat of his secret being exposed looms over him.

name: Το Καρέ της Ντάμας
summary: Four close friends Marina, Katerina, Gianna and Aliki who have been together since their childhood share their issues which each other but they also live together the pleasant and difficult moments of their lives. Marina, who lives with her mother Venetia, meets the man of her life Demosthenes who seems to be interested in her, Katerina and Aliki are married while Gianna is divorced and raising her son alone.

name: The Perfect Lie
summary: Two people remember the same fateful night—but their stories don't match. As a teacher and a cardiac surgeon clash over what really happened, the truth becomes a dangerous game of memory and lies.

name: ЧС. Чрезвычайная ситуация
summary: An emergency response team who are constantly looking for a balance between their own happiness and self-sacrifice for the sake of saving others.

name: Buckingham Palace: A Year in the Life
summary: The secrets of Britain's most iconic royal home over the year, season by season.

name: The Space Race in Colour
summary: Featuring stunning colour footage, the story of one of the great technological triumphs - leading from World War Two to the first man in space and the 1969 Apollo moon landing.

name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
summary: Follows 33 miners trapped more than half a mile underground in northern Chile for 69 days as rescuers race to save them while the men fight to survive.

name: The Arena: Saturday
summary: Kasie Hunt brings key players into the arena for sharp analysis and panel discussion on the week's news in politics and culture.

name: I.CINNAMOROLL
summary: I.CINNAMOROLL Animation is a different kind of Cinnamoroll story, one that imagines him living in the human world. Here you'll see Cinnamoroll's relaxing daily life, as he truly values a mindset of self-care. Even if it's not a sparkling day, he naps, plays, and tries new things…He used to think he had to "do it right," but maybe it's better to be a little relaxed?

name: Just One Before I Die
summary: Just One Before I Die chronicles "Bills Mafia," the most passionate and wild fanbase in sports in their quest for an elusive championship. From legendary tailgates and table-smashing traditions to lifelong rituals, heartbreak, hope, and unwavering loyalty, the series captures the culture that has transformed the "Bills Mafia" from a fanbase into a phenomenon.

name: Sabor a ti
summary:
Following her grandmother's death, agronomist and winemaker Ángela Herrera returns to Montealegre, where she discovers that her family was robbed of a valuable formula that turned El Embrujo de Rosa into the region's most prestigious wine. Determined to reclaim her family's legacy, she joins forces with Tomás Sarmiento, the grandson of Vicente Sarmiento, the Herrera family's longtime enemy. As they set out to uncover the truth, Ángela captures the heart of Mariano, Vicente's right-hand man and the fiancé of Lucero, a young woman who was adopted by Ángela's grandmother.

Amid secrets, rivalries and divided loyalties, love and the search for truth will put everyone's future at risk.

summary: As Sweden heads toward a national election, Mauri Hermundsson gets behind the wheel as party leaders from all eight parliamentary parties take turns acting as his driving instructors. While navigating the roads of Sweden, they also answer questions about leadership, power, politics, and life beyond the public spotlight.

name: Sabor a ti
summary: The story revolves around Ángela Herrera, a young winemaker who arrives at the "El Embrujo" vineyard, owned by Refugio Sarmiento, a powerful businessman who hides a secret capable of explaining why his wine was the best in the area. Conflict arises when Ángela, mistaken for her mother by her dying grandmother, decides to stay in the countryside. There she meets Feliciano Calquín, a man of the land, distrustful and clumsy, but deeply connected to the vineyards.

name: The Parsifal Mosaic
summary: In The Parsifal Mosaic, after years of dangerous field work for the CIA, Michael Havelock is ready to get out of the game when he learns that his partner Jenna Karas  – secretly the love of his life – has betrayed him, and begins unravelling a powerful conspiracy that reaches around the globe.

name: Αν Υπήρχες θα σε Χώριζα
summary: Revenge is feminine. Nontas is a successful theatrical entrepreneur who also runs other businesses and at the same time maintains relationships with three women. Two wives and a mistress. And he loves all three! His first wife has dynamism, the second has incredible humor and the third with her romance gives color to his life. Nontas has everything under control until a series of unfortunate events brings him face to face with a corpse that needs to be disposed of and a baby that is most likely his.

name: What Now with Trevor Noah
summary: On each episode of What Now? we dive deep into conversation with special guests from entertainers, CEOs, actors, athletes, and thought leaders. Join me each week for authentic back-and-forth conversations with honest reactions with new episodes dropping frequently. Subscribe to be the first to see them!

name: Narnia
summary:
Netflix is releasing as a movie adaptation

Step through the wardrobe into Narnia, where courage, friendship, and epic battles between good and evil await.

name: The Reluctant Vampire
summary:
Set in a timeless English village, where everything is picturesque, everything, that is, except for the vampires living in the castle on the hill who come out at night for a little drink of the locals.

Val has been raised in a very typical vampire family but has always felt a bit different and hopelessly inept at rising to meet his Dad's high standards. Following a surprise encounter with his reflection, he realises he is not undead, not in the least bit.

Now with a big secret to hide, Val must navigate finding out who he truly is, by mingling with the locals to learn the intricacies of their behaviour and what it means to be human. Caught between two worlds as he loves his Mum and Dad (not so much his jealous brother) and has full vampire duties expected of him by his father, whose obsession with the traditional way of life is tricky when they're undead and the villagers despise them.

name: The Jackie Thomas Show
summary: Jackie Thomas  is a famous standup-comic starring in his own sitcom titled "The Jackie Thomas Show." Backstage, he's a loudmouth tyrant, but with a heart.

name: Joe and Sons
summary: Proudly Italian-American working-class widower Joe Vitale is raising his teenage boys Mark and Nick in Hoboken, New Jersey with help from his Aunt Florence. He hangs out with pal Gus and waitress neighbor Estelle.

name: Shaman Girl and Her Mr. CEO
summary:
Park Seon A, a young shaman who is losing her spiritual powers due to a lack of yang energy, discovers that Lee Jae U, a wheelchair-bound billionaire heir, possesses overwhelming yang energy but suffers greatly because of it.

To secure his family's conglomerate and to help Seon A continue her life as a shaman, the two enter into a contract. With his yang energy, Seon A regains the power to perform spells and repeatedly overcomes dangerous situations, while Jae U gradually recovers the use of his legs thanks to her. Together, they defeat Jae U's villainous uncle and Mi Gyeong, Seon A's aunt and a corrupt doctor, before falling in love and choosing to spend the rest of their lives together.

name: Husdrømmen Med Halvor Bakke
summary: Vi følger nordmenn som realiserer unike boligdrømmer. Interiørdesigneren Halvor Bakke gir råd og tipser om smarte løsninger underveis.

name: John Sessions' Tall Tales
summary: A series of one-man plays written and performed by John Sessions and recorded at London's Half Moon Theatre.

name: It Has Always Been You
summary: Lin Zhixia moves into her brother-in-law's home to care for her ill sister but faces harassment. In a twist of fate, she marries Shen Yanci, the powerful figure behind Jingshi Group. Unbeknownst to her, he has kept a pendant she lost three years ago and orchestrated their meeting by acquiring a matchmaking agency. He protects her from troubles while she endures in silence to shield her sister. When her brother-in-law threatens her sister, leading to her collapse, Lin finally stands up for herself. Shen arrives just in time, proving his long-standing affection. Overcoming hardships together, they announce their relationship at a gathering and hold a belated wedding with her sister as a witness.

name: Class Clown
summary:
A misfit crew of comedians head back to school in the all-new series Class Clowns.

Under the watchful eye of Principal Julia Morris, comedians Bron Lewis and Luke McGregor, Becky Lucas, Matt Okine, Nina Oyama and Dave Hughes, are divided into three houses, Redbacks, Cane Toads and Bin Chickens, to battle it out for house points and the coveted Class Clowns Cup.

From Biology and Drama to Mathematics, Geography, Gymnastics, Physics and more, every assignment offers the chance to earn praise and points. But impressing Principal Morris won't come easy. As she reminds her students, house points are a privilege, not a right.

Packed with outrageous challenges, fierce competition and plenty of laughs, Class Clowns proves that even professional comedians will do almost anything for bragging rights and a trophy.

name: Ιατρικό Απόρρητο
summary: At a state of the art surgical clinic, a team of doctors faces challenging operations, medical emergencies, and life or death decisions on a daily basis. As they struggle to save their patients, they must also navigate their own ambitions, relationships, rivalries, and personal dilemmas, while the pressures of life inside the hospital often collide with the complications of life outside it.

name: King of Diamonds
summary: John King, the two-fisted, globe-trotting chief of security for the world's diamond industry, travels the world battling jewel thieves and gem smugglers. Assisted by his young protégé, Casey O'Brien, King matches wits with the criminal gang that calls itself the Illegal Diamond Buyers' Syndicate.

name: The Jane Show
summary: The Jane Show is a funny and warm look at 30-something Jane Black's life, after reluctantly putting aside her aspirations as a writer to become a full-time member of the 'normal' nine-to-five world - only to discover it's anything but. Maybe that starving artist thing wasn't so bad after all?

name: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?
summary:
Spring—the first day of the new school term.
After the class changes, it was the first day of the new term.
Sitting next to me was the person everyone had rumored to be a troublemaker.

With doll-like skin, flushed eyes, and strangely red lips, and a perpetually melancholic expression, Chihara Mai is a high school girl who exudes the
typical "landmine" vibe . Kuroki, a plain-looking boy who has just entered his second year of high school, finds himself sitting next to Chihara, who is rumored to be a dangerous person. However, the Chihara he sees up close seems a little different from the girl the rumors describe...

name: Deception: World War II
summary: Deception: World War II is a four-part chronological series that weaves tales of the deception and countermeasures, used by both sides of the Second World War to deadly effect. Tracking six years of conflict, this series uses a wealth of archive footage and expert interviews to explore astounding stories of subterfuge and covert operations. From propaganda disinformation campaigns and daring acts of espionage behind enemy lines, to the creation of fictional armies, Deception: World War II picks apart various wartime operations and looks at the men and women who managed to fool entire governments and armies.

previousepisode.name: The Final Days of the War

name: Jamie's 20 Minute Meals
summary: Short on time and want something fast? Jamie Oliver shows us how to make gorgeous meals in just 20 minutes.

name: Late Night Horror
summary: Series of plays featuring horror-fantasy themes.

name: The Cruel Tribunal
summary: Modern-day lawyer Jiang Xiaobai finds herself transported to the ancient kingdom of Bojie, where she uses her legal expertise to fight for justice on behalf of the powerless. She challenges deeply rooted customs, including the practice of selling wives, and is eventually entrusted with the task of revising the kingdom's laws. Along the way, she and Prince Sizhou go from misunderstandings to an unexpected bond, eventually pledging their lives to one another. But their love is soon caught in the dangerous struggle for power within the imperial court, as rival factions battle for the throne. Caught between love, justice, and political intrigue, Jiang Xiaobai must hold firmly to her principles and stay true to herself.

name: The Lawless Years
summary: Barney Ruditsky is a New York City police officer in the Roaring '20s who fights organized crime. The show is loosely based on the real-life Ruditsky, who was a New York police officer during the period.

name: El buen espíritu: Detrás de la puerta del Opus Dei
summary: Men from diverse backgrounds detail the spiritual, psychological, and financial abuse they experienced under the religious group Opus Dei.

name: First Doctor
summary: First Doctor is a medical drama centered on a pediatric surgery unit on the verge of closure, and the people who battle through yet another crisis to protect the most fragile lives.

name: Decoding You
summary: Krit, the polished CEO of a data analytics empire, has always put family and duty above his own heart. When a scandal linked to his ex-lover tarnishes his reputation, his controlling mother forces him into a fake marriage with Non—his adopted younger brother who has secretly loved him for years. What begins as a staged arrangement soon turns real as Non steps out of Krit's shadow and catches someone else's eye, awakening emotions Krit can no longer deny. But when their relationship sparks a public scandal, Krit must choose between protecting the perfect life he's built or risking everything for a love he never expected.

name: The New Adventures of Kimba the White Lion
summary: Leo is a young ambitious lion cub who takes his father's place as emperor of the jungle when is father is killed by poachers. Even though his father's fate was met by the hands of humans, Leo is one of the few animals in the Jungle that doesn't fear or feel hatred toward humans. He is not alone either, he is guided by friends of his father to help create the best animal kingdom there can be.

name: Murciélago
summary: Koumori Kuroko, a former death-row inmate chosen through extraordinary legal measures to serve as a state-sanctioned executioner. By her side is her watchdog and partner, Tozakura Hinako, whose extraordinary driving skills are second to none. As one heinous crime after another lands on their doorstep, the strongest duo takes on the darkness lurking within society.

name: Nos enfants chéris: La série
summary: Reunited sweethearts Martin and Constance head to a country home for a summer retreat with their blended family and a baby on the way. Expecting peace, their getaway quickly devolves into a chaos of unruly kids, intrusive exes, and unresolved romantic baggage that tests their relationship to its limits.

name: Magical Girl Raising Project Restart
summary: The hit social network game "The Magical Girl Raising Project" selects one out of every tens of thousands of players to become a real life magical girl. The lucky chosen girls gain magic powers as well as incredibly good fortune, and spend their days blissfully. But one day, an absolute announcement declares that the number of magical girls has risen too high and must be cut down to half. Sixteen young maidens are thrust into a merciless, deadly contest to survive...but how many will come out the other side.

name: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
summary: Psychic investigators don't normally use their powers to lie, cheat, and get ahead. But super psychic policeman Meguru Chojo does. Relegated to a run-down police station and hated by the entire neighborhood, Chojo gets into all sorts of shenanigans, goofs, and gaffes with his rookie partner, Nao Ippongi. Together, they turn the police force into a farce.

name: TETSURYO! Meet With Tetsudou Musume
summary: Misaki wants to escape her everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere. And while she doesn't yet know what she will be in the future, Misaki knows for certain that she wants to find something she is passionate about. Soon after arriving on campus to start her college life, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Club. Misaki's heart now beats with excitement for the new world that lies ahead on the railway.

name: Beast King War God Dandivine
summary: 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll, the world is now at peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, which relied on its Dandivine merchandise, has declined. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

name: Welsh & Shedar
summary: The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world.

name: Combat Mecha Xabungle
summary:
On the planet Zora exist two societies: the Innocent, an advanced culture that lives in domed cities, and the Civilians, who are forced to live in the harsh desert wilderness. As dictated by the Innocent, any Civilian that commits a crime is forgiven if they are not brought to justice within three days.

Civilian Jiron Amos seeks revenge on the villainous outlaw Timp Sharon who murdered his parents, despite the fact the three-day period has long since passed. Hoping to get his revenge by stealing the mecha Xabungle from the merchant Carrying Cargo, Jiron teams up with a group of bandits known as the Sandrats and kidnaps Cargo's daughter Elchi, who ends up being sympathetic to his cause. Jiron's quest for revenge soon grows into a conflict much bigger—one that will eventually see the Civilians rise up against the Innocents' rule.

name: На высоте
summary: A NEW high-tech show where everything will simply FLY.

name: Shasha and Milo
summary: Shasha and Milo are the newly activated Crescent Moon Guardians. Imbued with the power to transform between human, cat and a formidable hybrid form, Shasha and Milo are tasked with protecting Crescent Island from the dark forces that lurk beneath it... whilst navigating the daily complexities of preteen life.

name: The Real Rooneys
summary: The Rooneys invite the cameras into their home for a pivotal year. It's all change as Wayne swaps football management for school runs, while Coleen embraces new opportunities. With unprecedented access, we follow them through the highs and lows of married life while raising four lively boys. This is Britain's most famous and private family as never seen before: warm, funny, and authentic.

name: στο CAMPING
summary: Coaxed down from his secluded hill life, a rugged local spends a scorching summer amidst foreign tourists and quirky workers at a seaside campsite, navigating fleeting romances and local rivalries until autumn sets in.
